5805-6495--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5805-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
5805-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2511-4153-4186--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1765-2440-7109-7297.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-7109-7297.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

628-2511-7187.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

4050-4766-5229-7091.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ulamog, adding {1}.
When Ulamog dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Ulamog trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Ulamog and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
4050-4766-5229-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Ulamog or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Ulamog with the returned creature for that iteration.

1894-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

46-518-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
46-518-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

38-659-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-6633.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

3812-5963-6478.description:
Activate Marvin using Arbor Adherent's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2018-5256--73.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
2018-5256--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

3017-3528-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3017-3528-3976.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
3017-3528-3976.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

575-4319-4779-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-4779-5441.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

4222-4720-4893-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4222-4720-4893-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

322-3518-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one basic land card in your hand or in your graveyard.
322-3518-5751.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding the basic land card.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast any other card(s) in your graveyard for their retrace costs, and return the basic land using Groundskeeper.

116-2569-4284.notablePrerequisites:
Clone is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Clone do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-4284.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Clone.
Activate Clone by tapping it.
When Clone becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Clone's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1170-1328-4251-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-4251-5223.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

188-2178-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
188-2178-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1027-3280-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Wildwood Scourge.
Any creature type except "Hydra" or "Frog" chosen with Conspiracy.
1027-3280-4875.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Wildwood Scourge that is a 1/1 Frog.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Wildwood Scourge.
The Wildwood Scourge who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.

1908-2972-3750.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.
1908-2972-3750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least two token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put the Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Ganax at least twice.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

423-511-3334-3510.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-3334-3510.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saprolings enter the battlefield as Forest lands due to Life and Limb, triggering Evolution Sage, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

1109-1636-2034-5319.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Messenger does not have any +1/+1 counters.
1109-1636-2034-5319.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
Geralf's Messenger dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Messenger.
Repeat.

793-1380-1636-2018-2838.notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
793-1380-1636-2018-2838.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Jewel-Eyed Cobra and Luminous Broodmoth triggers.
Resolve the Jewel-Eyed Cobra triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Jewel-Eyed Cobra to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a flying counter from Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Repeat.

1584-2026-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
1584-2026-3525.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

224-872-3861.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.
